name: Bynder
description: Bynder is a digital asset management platform for organizing, governing, and distributing brand content. Marketing and creative teams use it to manage media libraries, metadata, collections, workflows, approvals, transformations, and delivery across channels.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Bynder OAuth app for the organization's portal, then let agents use the portal's documented asset, collection, metadata, workflow, analytics, webhook, and administration APIs under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: BYNDER_PORTAL_DOMAIN
credentialRequirements.label: Bynder portal
credentialRequirements.helpText: The organization's Bynder portal hostname, such as acme.bynder.com.

credentialRequirements.name: BYNDER_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create an OAuth app in the organization's Bynder portal and copy its client ID.

credentialRequirements.name: BYNDER_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the one-time client secret when the Bynder OAuth app is created.

capabilities.label: Browse digital assets
capabilities.description: Read authorized assets, metadata, collections, users, workflows, orders, analytics, quarantine records, and webhook configuration.

capabilities.label: Manage digital assets
capabilities.description: Create and change assets, metadata, collections, workflows, orders, webhooks, users, and other portal-authorized resources.

allowed.label: Read Bynder data
allowed.description: Run one bounded GET operation inside the connected Bynder portal's documented API surface.

approvalRequired.label: Change Bynder data
approvalRequired.description: Run one documented Bynder mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: OAuth secrets, access tokens, refresh tokens, authorization headers, cookies, and signed delivery URLs never enter agent-visible results.

blocked.label: Call another origin
blocked.description: Requests remain pinned to the HTTPS Bynder portal saved with the connection.

blocked.label: Transfer unbounded data
blocked.description: Relay bounds request and response bodies and does not follow redirects.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; every mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected portal- and scope-authorized Bynder API operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, provider permissions, fixed origin, bounds, redaction, audits, rate limits, and provider enforcement still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts bounded Bynder API wrappers against the connection's fixed customer portal.
Railway mounts bounded Bynder API wrappers against the connection's fixed customer portal.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Bynder portal, an administrator with OAuth Apps access, provider enablement where required, and a customer-owned client ID and one-time client secret are not available for production acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Bynder administrator enables OAuth Apps if needed, registers https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/bynder/callback with the required scopes, then enters the portal hostname, client ID, and client secret in Relay Console and completes connection verification.

evidence.supports: Bynder documents OAuth 2 bearer authentication, its current scope set, portal APIs, rate limits, and identifier formats.

Bynder documents portal-admin creation of customer-specific OAuth apps, callback registration, one-time client secrets, immutable scopes, refresh-token revocation, and support enablement where required.
Bynder publishes its current endpoint reference across assets, collections, metadata, workflows, automation, PIM, Brand Store, analytics, quarantine, webhooks, users, and profiles.
Bynder describes a digital asset management platform for brand content, creative workflows, governance, and delivery.
